recommendation: Keep the source fix as-is. It removes the remaining contradictory Practitioner wording from the authoritative StructureDefinition while preserving the WG-approved invariant and actor semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-32507 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification for R5. It requested that Procedure.performer.onBehalfOf not provide a second way to say a Practitioner is acting for an Organization, because PractitionerRole is the appropriate representation, and required an invariant excluding Practitioner and PractitionerRole actors.
initial_application: The issue was first applied in commit 12c0383ef875059f3622e2c076afe35997217b74, which updated the Procedure.performer.onBehalfOf definition/comment and added prc-1. Commit 44eb023f8ef6470c85eba821dceccfa284f1a693 then fixed the invariant placement/expression. The current source already had the final definition, comment, and invariant, but still had stale short and requirements text referring to a practitioner.
additional_context: Procedure is active build input via source/fhir.ini. Patient Care WGM minutes in January 2023 record review/vote on FHIR-32507. Jira/Zulip/Confluence searches found no later core decision reversing the Jira resolution; FHIR-33394 only shared the implementation commit and FHIR-41137 is a FHIR-us-ccda mapping issue outside this core reconciliation.
reconciliation: Changed source/procedure/structuredefinition-Procedure.xml so Procedure.performer.onBehalfOf short says the Organization the performer was acting for, and requirements refer to allowed actor types rather than Practitioners and Devices. The already-correct definition, comment, target profile, and prc-1 invariant were left unchanged.
source_changes: source/procedure/structuredefinition-Procedure.xml: updated Procedure.performer.onBehalfOf short from device/practitioner wording to performer wording.
source/procedure/structuredefinition-Procedure.xml: updated Procedure.performer.onBehalfOf requirements to refer to allowed actor types instead of Practitioners and Devices.
